Name: Shrimp Hat
Author: feen1e
Description:
This mod adds a single shrimp hat. We made it for our new Shrimpy Farm save 🦐🦐
By default, the hat is available at Hat Mouse's shop for 659 gold but you can change that by editing config.json or using Generic Mod Config Menu.

To install, you just need to unzip the contents into the Mods folder.

This mod requires Content Patcher.
